adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw-HTML import path that bypasses Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` parses a remote feed via `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and passes `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` directly into `TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no sanitization. `TopicEmbed.import` creates the post with `PostCreator.new(..., raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])`. `Post#cook` then returns `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == :raw_html`, skipping the rendering pipeline. The embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), meaning any `<script>`/event-handler HTML from the feed becomes stored XSS on the Discourse origin. The feed is fetched via `open(...)` and can be plain HTTP depending on the setting, making compromise/MITM a realistic injection vector.
